reviews.title: Does what it says!
reviews.comment: So far so good! Original ram was 16gb 3200 MHz, wasn’t exactly looking for something faster per say, but was looking for a good 32gb kit. This kit fit that requirement PLUS is a little bit faster at 3600 MHz! So far am really happy for the price of this, and the colors match my pc too so that’s an added bonus. Do want to add that when manually setting the speed, the system did crash twice. Changed over to the XMP profile and now it seems very stable. Only been running for a day but no crashes yet! Will update if something goes wrong. AWESOME
reviews.author: Dominic
